searchText: <@!386151184869752834> any of the cloud providers you guys integrated support BLS12-381 sigs? We've been developing a Hashicorp vault plugin for eth2 validators https://github.com/bloxapp/vault-plugin-secrets-eth2.0/tree/stage <@636950487089938462> that s pretty damn cool. we ve been experimenting with eth2signer and hashicorp vault mostly. i don t think any cloud has production ready bls, but almost everybody is working on it i expect autumn to be full of announcements in this direction is there any eth2 client that works with your signer s interface <@636950487089938462> ? all i looked at seem to have a simpler sign root interface rather than giving you all the available data to process i much prefer your version though.. Yeah we have, we will be making that available soon. You must have all the data to actually have slashing protection on the wallet level... otherwise the keys are very susceptible for a signing request that can cause slashing. Most don't realize that slashing penalties are dynamic, meaning that more people get slashed the bigger the penalty is. Using a service that holds your validation keys (or has unfiltered access to them) is very dangerous, the bigger the service the bigger the penalties on individual users. exactly 😄

Yeah we have, we will be making that available soon. 
You must have all the data to actually have slashing protection on the wallet level... otherwise the keys are very susceptible for a signing request that can cause slashing.  

Most don't realize that slashing penalties are dynamic, meaning that more people get slashed the bigger the penalty is. 
Using a service that holds your validation keys (or has unfiltered access to them) is very dangerous, the bigger the service the bigger the penalties on individual users.
